Ethnicity.description: Ethnic background of the individual. Recommended is the use of a value from NCIT Race (NCIT:C17049) ontology term descendants, e.g. NCIT:C126531 (Latin American). A geographic ancestral origin category that is assigned to a population group based mainly on physical characteristics that are thought to be distinct and inherent. [ NCI ]

GeographicLocation.description: Country or region of origin of the individual (birthplace or residence place regardless of ethnic origin). Value from GAZ Geographic Location ontology (GAZ:00000448), e.g. GAZ:00002459 (United States of America).

KaryotypicSex.description:
The chromosomal sex of an individual represented from a selection of options. The values correspond to the ordinal values in the Phenopackets schema where:
* UNKNOWN_KARYOTYPE: Untyped or inconclusive karyotyping * XX:   Female * XY:   Male * XO:   Single X chromosome only * XXY:  Two X and one Y chromosome * XXX:  Three X chromosomes * XXYY: Two X chromosomes and two Y chromosomes * XXXY: Three X chromosomes and one Y chromosome * XXXX: Four X chromosomes * XYY:  One X and two Y chromosomes * OTHER_KARYOTYPE: None of the above types
Source: Phenopackets v2 `KaryotypicSex`

SeverityLevel.description: Severity as applicable to phenotype or disease observed; the intensity or degree of a manifestation. Recommended are values from Human Phenotype Ontology (HP:0012824), e.g `mild`.  Source: Phenopackets v2

Sex.description:
An enumeration used to represent the sex of an individual. This element does not represent gender identity or KaryotypicSex, but instead represents typical “phenotypic sex”, as would be determined by a midwife or physician at birth.
* UNKNOWN_SEX: Not assessed or not available. Maps to NCIT:C17998 * FEMALE: Female sex. Maps to NCIT:C46113 * MALE: Male sex. Maps to NCIT:C46112 * OTHER_SEX: It is not possible to accurately assess the applicability of
  MALE/FEMALE. Maps to NCIT:C45908

Source: Phenopackets v2 `Sex`

Timestamp.description: Time in date-time ISO8601 string format.

Unit.description: The kind of unit. Recommended are descendants from NCIT Unit of Category ontology term (NCIT:C42568)

description: Definitions for concepts used in several entry types, but that having only one property are not complex enough to require a full independent schema document.
title: Common Definitions
